body:
## Project goal
Deliver a private personal PAL that retains relevant conversational context, accepts natural requests, asks only indispensable human judgments/content, prepares authorized reversible local results, verifies outcomes and returns results/blockers/decisions without requiring the user to manage internal tasks.

## Authority and plan
G-001 governance is ACTIVE by direct owner instruction. Stable-1 independently ACTIVE under D-021, adopted P002, and the latest owner-directed D028/D029 model-led Primary correction. Canonical decisions: DECISIONS.md; continuation: STATE.md. Reasoning-solvable technical choices remain autonomous. P-001 v2 is the latest frozen PROPOSED future plan (docs/plans/P-001-v2.md, SHA256 d7b931b06246a9a56be0f22234e309a99e2d4b4e90da25f6ac66226ddfcd5397); future activation is dormant until a concrete material scope decision is needed, not a blocker for current work. No future scope adoption is inferred.

## Project acceptance
G-P01: every required adopted milestone gate with release-version evidence PASS.
G-P02: precommitted integrated workloads/rubric prove context → recall → request → necessary question → local preparation → verified return, not just isolated components.
G-P03: control/security/forget/recovery/bounded official cost and blocker audit hold at integration.
G-P04: authentic human overall usefulness, final suite/version/use/limits record and project-goal audit before closure.
All project gates are NOT_RUN until the plan is adopted and demonstrated. Closed child issues are not project completion. Stable-0 completion remains intact, not overall completion.

## Goal loops and checkpoints
Each Issue: goal/criteria/dependencies → bounded unit → required review → test/implement/verify/evidence/commit/push → evaluate unit contribution → next unmet condition. Close only after objective verification. Milestone aggregates but independently verifies its user-visible promise. Project independently verifies integrated usefulness.
Checkpoints: coherent green unit, Issue exit, milestone exit/entry, and defect/repeated cause/user feedback/assumption failure. Record goal verdict, evidence/version, remaining uncertainty, plan impact and exact next step. No timer/checkpoint keepalive.

## Plan changes
Material plan/scope/acceptance/priority change: Opus discuss/agreement → versioned proposal with evidence/delta/recommendation/affected vs independent work → actual targeted human decision → canonical docs/GitHub activation. Pending decision blocks only its dependencies. Routine technical choices/bug fixes within approved scope remain autonomous. Only ACTIVE approved milestones enter execution.

## Next
C047 checkpoint (evidence 22418b9): HR-ACCESS-002 is resolved. The direct owner action was received and the same official SWE-2 High Free review completed with workspace trust respected (134.740s), after fresh existing-auth/Free checks. No new login/payment/global trust override. Official Opus C046 review and D029 C047 adoption precede implementation.

A test-only existing-fault-seam probe now proves actual controlled late-result fencing on candidate c44d3b4/product53a616: two frozen Japanese UI inputs, three actual native slots, same running Goal cancelled at epoch+1 and its Attempt fenced, exact matching stale-artifact rejection, zero accepted artifacts/receipts/outcomes/questions/approvals. Six-event fsync chain, read-only DB and source hashes independently verified. Normal closure200.824s/exit0; owned PID gone and port explicitly ECONNREFUSED.19 focused tests and268 full tests PASS24.048s. All17 product files unchanged.

Evidence: https://github.com/thattor/personal-agent-lab/blob/22418b983d91012760244f6bd3575170417b6da4/evidence/reviews/judgment-boundary/c047-controlled-cancel/README.md

Scope is controlled delivery after real Executor return, not upstream generation cancellation or natural timing reliability. Original C035/C045 timing results remain unchanged. C045 ABS-A1 and TARGET-A/B PASS retain their bindings; ABS-A2 NOT_VERIFIED after explicit browser-client block, nine artifact-dependent hosts NOT_RUN. C043 recognition proof remains unchanged-component evidence with original versions. No whole N1 or release promotion.

Next: resolve the actual browser access condition through a supported allowed path before remaining artifact-dependent frozen UI cases; no alternate content access, blind retry, proof renewal or new calls while blocked. Then one current-candidate whole-flow owner usefulness evaluation and final acceptance/version/limits audit. No repeated trust request or routine technical micro-question. Qwen3.8-27B remains the owner's capability reference; actual PAL qualification NOT_RUN. Stable0 released; Stable1 and overall PAL incomplete. No old quotas, stopped schedule restart, paid fallback or external exposure.

Private Projects board https://github.com/users/thattor/projects/1 is created, linked and populated; HR-PERM is fulfilled, no device authorization wait. Overall goal remains incomplete. Qwen3.8-27B is the owner's capability reference, not yet PAL-qualified. No new authentication, cost, external sending/publication, old soak quota or scheduled wake is authorized by these records.

C048 execution checkpoint: controller goal is BLOCKED after the same residual browser artifact-access condition at C047 exit and two automatic continuations. No supported clearance, new human answer or independent required slice was found; this is not a live-process wait. The overall objective, accepted Stable1 scope and N1 criteria are unchanged. Resume fixed affected UI cases only after supported artifact access is established, then one actual current whole-flow usefulness evaluation and final release audit. No repeated trust request, invented browser-unlock instruction, provider/proof retry, guard bypass or schedule restart.268-test source remains unchanged. Audit: https://github.com/thattor/personal-agent-lab/blob/03c11fe86402213ddb43306a2109c2259ce3723b/evidence/operations/c048-blocked-audit.json . Stable1 and overall project remain incomplete.
